conventions.note: Offsets are 1-based, as measured (WS-CW-ACCOUNT = 1, WS-CW-NAME = 11). Lengths are byte counts. A level-88 has no storage and carries null, never zero.

source_vocabulary.gap: DERIVED by subtraction, not measured. FILLER and SYNC slack cannot receive a MOVE and are recoverable only as the bytes no named field claims.
